ShortDescription: Spectacular 1880’s former boarding house; the only remaining house on College Avenue with its original tower; a local landmark. Grand View House was historically and sympathetically renovated from 2000 to 2003. Each apartment has a new kitchen and bathroom(s), windows, and refinished floors. All mechanical systems are new. The quality of the rehabilitation and renovation work done to Grand View House was recognized by awards from the City of Ithaca, Ithaca Rotary Club, and Historic Ithaca and Tompkins County. An addition to the rear of the original 1880s structure houses two studio, two 1-BR, and one 2-BR apartments, all constructed to Grand View House standards. Five-minute walk to the Cornell campus Assigned reserved parking spaces available for rent Zoned heat (thermostat in every apartment) Heat, cold & hot water, trash and recycling pickup are included in the rental prices Phone and cable jacks in every bedroom Pre-wired for internet (service not provided) 100% fire detection and sprinkler systems Front door intercom system to screen to admit callers to Grand View House Laundry room with front-loading washers on premises Fully furnished

We still have several nice rooms available for this Spring Semester starting January 2027 the summer Semester, and also the 2026-27 school year starting August 2026. Tenants rent their individually private locked rooms, but share common spaces. The rent price is all inclusive of all utilities with no cap on electricity. Our house is in the heart of Collegetown, 1-3 minutes from the business , law and engineering schools and the numerous shops & restaurants. We provide free cleaning of common rooms, free trash collection,free High speed Internet, and free premium cable TV. It is a Large sunny Victorian house with lots of traditional bay windows , high ceilings. and spacious rooms, This house is quiet, clean, safe, and friendly. Common Areas are cleaned weekly We try to provide a pleasant and comfortable home from home . It is family managed by individuals who had a life long experience in the hospitality trade by being owners and managers of family owned hotels, pubs and ***.******.*** care about the well being of our students. Come and see our rooms and join the students at 301 Dryden Rd ! You may also email us and we will send you photos *****@***.*** Jonathan and Katharina Steel

ShortDescription: We are a traditional student residence with a prime Collegetown location one block away from the Cornell campus main entrance. We are now renting our rooms, and apartment for this next 2027 Spring and Summer Semester and also for the 2026-27 starting August 1.2026. We still have several nice rooms available for this Spring Semester starting January 2027 the summer Semester, and also the 2026-27 school year starting August 2026. Tenants rent their individually private locked rooms, but share common spaces. The rent price is all inclusive of all utilities with no cap on electricity. Our house is in the heart of Collegetown, 1-3 minutes from the business , law and engineering schools and the numerous shops & restaurants. We provide free cleaning of common rooms, free trash collection,free High speed Internet, and free premium cable TV. It is a Large sunny Victorian house with lots of traditional bay windows , high ceilings. and spacious rooms, This house is quiet, clean, safe, and friendly. Common Areas are cleaned weekly We try to provide a pleasant and comfortable home from home . It is family managed by individuals who had a life long experience in the hospitality trade by being owners and managers of family owned hotels, pubs and ***.******.*** care about the well being of our students. Come and see our rooms and join the students at 301 Dryden Rd ! You may also email us and we will send you photos *****@***.*** Jonathan and Katharina Steel

ShortDescription: The Williams House at 306 N Cayuga St is an elegant 4 story historical building, with classic decor and styling reminiscent of an upscale turn of the century Neo-Colonial Revival Townhouse. It is Centrally located in the heart of Downtown, just 2 blocks from the Commons and across the street from the picturesque Dewitt Park. The hustle and bustle of a busy downtown is easily escaped within the quiet atmosphere afforded to you at the home of Travis Hyde Proprieties main office. During Spring, Summer, and Fall the Ithaca's Farmers Market, directly across the street in Dewitt Park, offers just picked produce, fresh cut flowers and deliciously prepared foods. The Williams House is one of the best locations downtown. With its close proximity to fine restaurants, the public library, downtown's premium shopping, and Ithaca's active nightlife, living at The Williams House offers incredible convenience for Professionals, Senior Citizens and Grad Students alike.

ShortDescription: 1-Bedroom Sublets Available – January 2027 Experience comfort and style in this beautifully renovated three-story home, perfectly situated between Downtown Ithaca and Collegetown. This spacious residence combines modern amenities with classic charm, offering an ideal living space for students and professionals alike. The kitchen has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and contemporary light fixtures. The bathrooms feature elegant new tilework, sleek vanities, and LED touch-activated mirrors, creating a bright and refined atmosphere. Each bedroom includes large windows that fill the space with natural light and a comfortable setup for both relaxation and productivity. This sublet comes fully furnished at no additional cost. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed Desk and chair Dresser House includes: Dining table Couch/sofa Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, professional lawn care, and snow removal—so you can enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle year-round. Pet lovers are welcome, as the property is cat and dog friendly (some breed restrictions apply). Conveniently located along a main street, this home offers easy access to both Downtown and Collegetown by foot, bike, or bus. A TCAT bus stop is located directly in front of the property, and you’ll be just moments away from the historic Argos Inn, a local favorite for craft cocktails and live music. This is an exceptional opportunity to live in a fully furnished, modernized home in one of Ithaca’s most desirable neighborhoods.

This spacious residence combines modern amenities with classic charm, offering an ideal living space for students and professionals alike. The kitchen has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and contemporary light fixtures. The bathrooms feature elegant new tilework, sleek vanities, and LED touch-activated mirrors, creating a bright and refined atmosphere. Each bedroom includes large windows that fill the space with natural light and a comfortable setup for both relaxation and productivity. This sublet comes fully furnished at no additional cost. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed Desk and chair Dresser House includes: Dining table Couch/sofa Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, professional lawn care, and snow removal—so you can enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle year-round. Pet lovers are welcome, as the property is cat and dog friendly (some breed restrictions apply). Conveniently located along a main street, this home offers easy access to both Downtown and Collegetown by foot, bike, or bus. A TCAT bus stop is located directly in front of the property, and you’ll be just moments away from the historic Argos Inn, a local favorite for craft cocktails and live music. ShortDescription: 1-Bedroom Sublets Available – January 2027 Experience comfort and style in this beautifully renovated three-story home, perfectly situated between Downtown Ithaca and Collegetown. This spacious residence combines modern amenities with classic charm, offering an ideal living space for students and professionals alike. The kitchen has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and contemporary light fixtures. The bathrooms feature elegant new tilework, sleek vanities, and LED touch-activated mirrors, creating a bright and refined atmosphere. Each bedroom includes large windows that fill the space with natural light and a comfortable setup for both relaxation and productivity. This sublet comes fully furnished at no additional cost. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed Desk and chair Dresser House includes: Dining table Couch/sofa Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, professional lawn care, and snow removal—so you can enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle year-round. Pet lovers are welcome, as the property is cat and dog friendly (some breed restrictions apply). Conveniently located along a main street, this home offers easy access to both Downtown and Collegetown by foot, bike, or bus. A TCAT bus stop is located directly in front of the property, and you’ll be just moments away from the historic Argos Inn, a local favorite for craft cocktails and live music. This is an exceptional opportunity to live in a fully furnished, modernized home in one of Ithaca’s most desirable neighborhoods.

ShortDescription: 1-Bedroom Sublets Available – January 2027 Experience comfort and style in this beautifully renovated three-story home, perfectly situated between Downtown Ithaca and Collegetown. This spacious residence combines modern amenities with classic charm, offering an ideal living space for students and professionals alike. The kitchen has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and contemporary light fixtures. The bathrooms feature elegant new tilework, sleek vanities, and LED touch-activated mirrors, creating a bright and refined atmosphere. Each bedroom includes large windows that fill the space with natural light and a comfortable setup for both relaxation and productivity. This sublet comes fully furnished at no additional cost. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed Desk and chair Dresser House includes: Dining table Couch/sofa Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, professional lawn care, and snow removal—so you can enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle year-round. Pet lovers are welcome, as the property is cat and dog friendly (some breed restrictions apply). Conveniently located along a main street, this home offers easy access to both Downtown and Collegetown by foot, bike, or bus. A TCAT bus stop is located directly in front of the property, and you’ll be just moments away from the historic Argos Inn, a local favorite for craft cocktails and live music. This is an exceptional opportunity to live in a fully furnished, modernized home in one of Ithaca’s most desirable neighborhoods.

ShortDescription: 1-Bedroom Sublets Available – January 2027 Experience comfort and style in this beautifully renovated three-story home, perfectly situated between Downtown Ithaca and Collegetown. This spacious residence combines modern amenities with classic charm, offering an ideal living space for students and professionals alike. The kitchen has been fully updated with brand-new stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and contemporary light fixtures. The bathrooms feature elegant new tilework, sleek vanities, and LED touch-activated mirrors, creating a bright and refined atmosphere. Each bedroom includes large windows that fill the space with natural light and a comfortable setup for both relaxation and productivity. This sublet comes fully furnished at no additional cost. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed Desk and chair Dresser House includes: Dining table Couch/sofa Additional features include an in-unit washer and dryer, professional lawn care, and snow removal—so you can enjoy a low-maintenance lifestyle year-round. Pet lovers are welcome, as the property is cat and dog friendly (some breed restrictions apply). Conveniently located along a main street, this home offers easy access to both Downtown and Collegetown by foot, bike, or bus. A TCAT bus stop is located directly in front of the property, and you’ll be just moments away from the historic Argos Inn, a local favorite for craft cocktails and live music. This is an exceptional opportunity to live in a fully furnished, modernized home in one of Ithaca’s most desirable neighborhoods.

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: One Monthly Payment. No Extra Bills. No Surprises. 108 Eddy Street, Ithaca, NY 4 Be drooms in Each Apa rtment | 2 Bathrooms in Each Apartment | 1,301–1,384 sq ft In the historic Greycourt building, steps from Cornell and the heartbeat of Collegetown, classic architecture meets modern living. Every apartment blends the building’s original charm with fully updated interiors, eco-efficient systems, and curated, move-in ready spaces designed to help you belong, connect, and succeed. At Foundation Housing, “all-inclusive” means everything really is included - not just utilities. One monthly installment covers: All utilities : heat, A/C, electricity, water, and trash High-speed Wi-Fi (1 GB available) Every room furnished and decorated comparable to what you see in the images All cooking and dining essentials provided Free cleaning service for all shared spaces Enhanced security with door monitoring, police/fire connection. Keyless entry to building, apartments & bedrooms. In-unit washer & dryer (not coin-operated) Dedicated customer support - fast, responsive, and student-focused Snow removal handled so winter is hassle-free This isn’t just convenience - it’s real value. Everything is rolled into one price, saving you time, stress, and unexpected expenses. Apartment Highlights: Historic Charm, Modern Comfort : Fully remodeled apartments that preserve Greycourt’s unique character while adding fresh finishes Shared Spaces Come Move-In Ready : Living and dining areas styled with comfortable, modern furniture and thoughtfully chosen décor - what you see in the photos really is what you get! Fully Furnished : Bedrooms include full-size memory foam Casper mattresses, desks, and dressers Fully Stocked Kitchen : Quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, Keurig coffee maker, dishwasher, and fully stocked with microwave, toaster, pots & pans, dishes, drinkware, cutting boards, baking sheets and cutlery Back patio space: Outdoor space perfect for relaxing, studying, dining, or spending time with friends. Smart TVs in common spaces for shared downtime or study use Thoughtful, Curated Decor : Coordinated furniture, framed artwork, and warm lighting create a boutique, student-friendly feel Collaboration & Study Spaces : Resident-only co-lab with conference table, private study rooms, whiteboards, lounge seating, and workout area with TV Eco-Efficient Upgrades : Appliances, electric systems, and building prep for solar panels—all part of our commitment to sustainability Spring '27 Special for a Group of 4!!

ShortDescription: Five Apartments. One Historic Downtown Property. Bring Your Group. Looking for a place where your entire group can live together while still having the privacy of separate apartments? Welcome to 232 S Geneva Street, a charming historic property in the heart of Downtown Ithaca featuring five separate apartments within one shared building. Located at the corner of Clinton Street and S Geneva Street, this property combines the character and warmth of a classic Ithaca home with an incredibly convenient Downtown location. For larger groups, the five-apartment layout creates a unique opportunity: live together at one property without having everyone share one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Depending on availability, groups can potentially combine multiple apartments within the building, allowing friends to live just steps away from one another while maintaining their own kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living spaces. Don't see an apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. We may be able to create a combination of available apartments that works for your group. The Best of Group Living & Apartment Living Large-group housing doesn't have to mean putting everyone into one giant apartment. At 232 S Geneva Street, your friends can potentially occupy several apartments within the same building. That means you can have your group nearby while still enjoying: Separate apartments Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Multiple living spaces More privacy between roommates Free on-site laundry Included off-street parking Your friends can be upstairs, downstairs, or right across the hall instead of several blocks—or several neighborhoods—away. Historic Ithaca Character 232 S Geneva Street has the welcoming character that's difficult to replicate in newer construction. The building's historic feel, abundant natural light, and comfortable residential atmosphere make it feel like a true Ithaca home rather than just another apartment building. Each of the five apartments has its own personality while sharing the warmth and charm of the larger property. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, creating bright and inviting spaces throughout the building. Free On-Site Laundry Forget about hauling your laundry to a laundromat. Free shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site within the building. The laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, and there is no additional charge to use it. Off-Street Parking Included Living Downtown doesn't have to mean fighting for street parking every night. Off-street parking is included at 232 S Geneva Street, providing residents with the convenience of parking directly at the property. That's an especially valuable amenity for a Downtown Ithaca location. Live Near the Ithaca Commons One of the biggest advantages of 232 S Geneva is its location. The property is just blocks from the Ithaca Commons and the heart of Downtown Ithaca, putting restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Walk Downtown for dinner. Meet friends for coffee. Head to the Commons for an event. Enjoy everything Ithaca has to offer without needing to get in your car. Convenient to Both Cornell & Ithaca College 232 S Geneva is also an excellent option for groups with students attending Cornell University, Ithaca College, or a combination of both. Its central Downtown location provides convenient access to both campuses. A bus stop is located on the block, with several additional stops nearby along Clinton, Fayette, and Green Streets, giving residents plenty of options for getting around Ithaca. Pet Friendly Bring your four-legged roommate! Dogs and cats are welcome. Some breed restrictions may apply, so please ask about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: Electricity Gas Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free on-site laundry Off-street parking A Unique Option for Your Group in Downtown Ithaca Finding housing for a large group can be challenging—especially if you want to stay Downtown. At 232 S Geneva Street, five separate apartments give groups the opportunity to stay together while still having the independence and privacy of individual living spaces. Whether you're looking for one apartment or trying to place a much larger group, tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help explore the available combinations. Your Friends. Your Apartments. One Historic Downtown Ithaca Home. Contact us today with your group size to discuss available combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: Five Apartments. One Historic Downtown Property. Bring Your Group. Looking for a place where your entire group can live together while still having the privacy of separate apartments? Welcome to 232 S Geneva Street, a charming historic property in the heart of Downtown Ithaca featuring five separate apartments within one shared building. Located at the corner of Clinton Street and S Geneva Street, this property combines the character and warmth of a classic Ithaca home with an incredibly convenient Downtown location. For larger groups, the five-apartment layout creates a unique opportunity: live together at one property without having everyone share one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Depending on availability, groups can potentially combine multiple apartments within the building, allowing friends to live just steps away from one another while maintaining their own kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living spaces. Don't see an apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. We may be able to create a combination of available apartments that works for your group. The Best of Group Living & Apartment Living Large-group housing doesn't have to mean putting everyone into one giant apartment. At 232 S Geneva Street, your friends can potentially occupy several apartments within the same building. That means you can have your group nearby while still enjoying: Separate apartments Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Multiple living spaces More privacy between roommates Free on-site laundry Included off-street parking Your friends can be upstairs, downstairs, or right across the hall instead of several blocks—or several neighborhoods—away. Historic Ithaca Character 232 S Geneva Street has the welcoming character that's difficult to replicate in newer construction. The building's historic feel, abundant natural light, and comfortable residential atmosphere make it feel like a true Ithaca home rather than just another apartment building. Each of the five apartments has its own personality while sharing the warmth and charm of the larger property. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, creating bright and inviting spaces throughout the building. Free On-Site Laundry Forget about hauling your laundry to a laundromat. Free shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site within the building. The laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, and there is no additional charge to use it. Off-Street Parking Included Living Downtown doesn't have to mean fighting for street parking every night. Off-street parking is included at 232 S Geneva Street, providing residents with the convenience of parking directly at the property. That's an especially valuable amenity for a Downtown Ithaca location. Live Near the Ithaca Commons One of the biggest advantages of 232 S Geneva is its location. The property is just blocks from the Ithaca Commons and the heart of Downtown Ithaca, putting restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Walk Downtown for dinner. Meet friends for coffee. Head to the Commons for an event. Enjoy everything Ithaca has to offer without needing to get in your car. Convenient to Both Cornell & Ithaca College 232 S Geneva is also an excellent option for groups with students attending Cornell University, Ithaca College, or a combination of both. Its central Downtown location provides convenient access to both campuses. A bus stop is located on the block, with several additional stops nearby along Clinton, Fayette, and Green Streets, giving residents plenty of options for getting around Ithaca. Pet Friendly Bring your four-legged roommate! Dogs and cats are welcome. Some breed restrictions may apply, so please ask about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: Electricity Gas Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free on-site laundry Off-street parking A Unique Option for Your Group in Downtown Ithaca Finding housing for a large group can be challenging—especially if you want to stay Downtown. At 232 S Geneva Street, five separate apartments give groups the opportunity to stay together while still having the independence and privacy of individual living spaces. Whether you're looking for one apartment or trying to place a much larger group, tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help explore the available combinations. Your Friends. Your Apartments. One Historic Downtown Ithaca Home. Contact us today with your group size to discuss available combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: Five Apartments. One Historic Downtown Property. Bring Your Group. Looking for a place where your entire group can live together while still having the privacy of separate apartments? Welcome to 232 S Geneva Street, a charming historic property in the heart of Downtown Ithaca featuring five separate apartments within one shared building. Located at the corner of Clinton Street and S Geneva Street, this property combines the character and warmth of a classic Ithaca home with an incredibly convenient Downtown location. For larger groups, the five-apartment layout creates a unique opportunity: live together at one property without having everyone share one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Depending on availability, groups can potentially combine multiple apartments within the building, allowing friends to live just steps away from one another while maintaining their own kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living spaces. Don't see an apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. We may be able to create a combination of available apartments that works for your group. The Best of Group Living & Apartment Living Large-group housing doesn't have to mean putting everyone into one giant apartment. At 232 S Geneva Street, your friends can potentially occupy several apartments within the same building. That means you can have your group nearby while still enjoying: Separate apartments Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Multiple living spaces More privacy between roommates Free on-site laundry Included off-street parking Your friends can be upstairs, downstairs, or right across the hall instead of several blocks—or several neighborhoods—away. Historic Ithaca Character 232 S Geneva Street has the welcoming character that's difficult to replicate in newer construction. The building's historic feel, abundant natural light, and comfortable residential atmosphere make it feel like a true Ithaca home rather than just another apartment building. Each of the five apartments has its own personality while sharing the warmth and charm of the larger property. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, creating bright and inviting spaces throughout the building. Free On-Site Laundry Forget about hauling your laundry to a laundromat. Free shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site within the building. The laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, and there is no additional charge to use it. Off-Street Parking Included Living Downtown doesn't have to mean fighting for street parking every night. Off-street parking is included at 232 S Geneva Street, providing residents with the convenience of parking directly at the property. That's an especially valuable amenity for a Downtown Ithaca location. Live Near the Ithaca Commons One of the biggest advantages of 232 S Geneva is its location. The property is just blocks from the Ithaca Commons and the heart of Downtown Ithaca, putting restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Walk Downtown for dinner. Meet friends for coffee. Head to the Commons for an event. Enjoy everything Ithaca has to offer without needing to get in your car. Convenient to Both Cornell & Ithaca College 232 S Geneva is also an excellent option for groups with students attending Cornell University, Ithaca College, or a combination of both. Its central Downtown location provides convenient access to both campuses. A bus stop is located on the block, with several additional stops nearby along Clinton, Fayette, and Green Streets, giving residents plenty of options for getting around Ithaca. Pet Friendly Bring your four-legged roommate! Dogs and cats are welcome. Some breed restrictions may apply, so please ask about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: Electricity Gas Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free on-site laundry Off-street parking A Unique Option for Your Group in Downtown Ithaca Finding housing for a large group can be challenging—especially if you want to stay Downtown. At 232 S Geneva Street, five separate apartments give groups the opportunity to stay together while still having the independence and privacy of individual living spaces. Whether you're looking for one apartment or trying to place a much larger group, tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help explore the available combinations. Your Friends. Your Apartments. One Historic Downtown Ithaca Home. Contact us today with your group size to discuss available combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: Five Apartments. One Historic Downtown Property. Bring Your Group. Looking for a place where your entire group can live together while still having the privacy of separate apartments? Welcome to 232 S Geneva Street, a charming historic property in the heart of Downtown Ithaca featuring five separate apartments within one shared building. Located at the corner of Clinton Street and S Geneva Street, this property combines the character and warmth of a classic Ithaca home with an incredibly convenient Downtown location. For larger groups, the five-apartment layout creates a unique opportunity: live together at one property without having everyone share one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Depending on availability, groups can potentially combine multiple apartments within the building, allowing friends to live just steps away from one another while maintaining their own kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living spaces. Don't see an apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. We may be able to create a combination of available apartments that works for your group. The Best of Group Living & Apartment Living Large-group housing doesn't have to mean putting everyone into one giant apartment. At 232 S Geneva Street, your friends can potentially occupy several apartments within the same building. That means you can have your group nearby while still enjoying: Separate apartments Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Multiple living spaces More privacy between roommates Free on-site laundry Included off-street parking Your friends can be upstairs, downstairs, or right across the hall instead of several blocks—or several neighborhoods—away. Historic Ithaca Character 232 S Geneva Street has the welcoming character that's difficult to replicate in newer construction. The building's historic feel, abundant natural light, and comfortable residential atmosphere make it feel like a true Ithaca home rather than just another apartment building. Each of the five apartments has its own personality while sharing the warmth and charm of the larger property. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, creating bright and inviting spaces throughout the building. Free On-Site Laundry Forget about hauling your laundry to a laundromat. Free shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site within the building. The laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, and there is no additional charge to use it. Off-Street Parking Included Living Downtown doesn't have to mean fighting for street parking every night. Off-street parking is included at 232 S Geneva Street, providing residents with the convenience of parking directly at the property. That's an especially valuable amenity for a Downtown Ithaca location. Live Near the Ithaca Commons One of the biggest advantages of 232 S Geneva is its location. The property is just blocks from the Ithaca Commons and the heart of Downtown Ithaca, putting restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Walk Downtown for dinner. Meet friends for coffee. Head to the Commons for an event. Enjoy everything Ithaca has to offer without needing to get in your car. Convenient to Both Cornell & Ithaca College 232 S Geneva is also an excellent option for groups with students attending Cornell University, Ithaca College, or a combination of both. Its central Downtown location provides convenient access to both campuses. A bus stop is located on the block, with several additional stops nearby along Clinton, Fayette, and Green Streets, giving residents plenty of options for getting around Ithaca. Pet Friendly Bring your four-legged roommate! Dogs and cats are welcome. Some breed restrictions may apply, so please ask about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: Electricity Gas Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free on-site laundry Off-street parking A Unique Option for Your Group in Downtown Ithaca Finding housing for a large group can be challenging—especially if you want to stay Downtown. At 232 S Geneva Street, five separate apartments give groups the opportunity to stay together while still having the independence and privacy of individual living spaces. Whether you're looking for one apartment or trying to place a much larger group, tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help explore the available combinations. Your Friends. Your Apartments. One Historic Downtown Ithaca Home. Contact us today with your group size to discuss available combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: Five Apartments. One Historic Downtown Property. Bring Your Group. Looking for a place where your entire group can live together while still having the privacy of separate apartments? Welcome to 232 S Geneva Street, a charming historic property in the heart of Downtown Ithaca featuring five separate apartments within one shared building. Located at the corner of Clinton Street and S Geneva Street, this property combines the character and warmth of a classic Ithaca home with an incredibly convenient Downtown location. For larger groups, the five-apartment layout creates a unique opportunity: live together at one property without having everyone share one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Depending on availability, groups can potentially combine multiple apartments within the building, allowing friends to live just steps away from one another while maintaining their own kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living spaces. Don't see an apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. We may be able to create a combination of available apartments that works for your group. The Best of Group Living & Apartment Living Large-group housing doesn't have to mean putting everyone into one giant apartment. At 232 S Geneva Street, your friends can potentially occupy several apartments within the same building. That means you can have your group nearby while still enjoying: Separate apartments Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Multiple living spaces More privacy between roommates Free on-site laundry Included off-street parking Your friends can be upstairs, downstairs, or right across the hall instead of several blocks—or several neighborhoods—away. Historic Ithaca Character 232 S Geneva Street has the welcoming character that's difficult to replicate in newer construction. The building's historic feel, abundant natural light, and comfortable residential atmosphere make it feel like a true Ithaca home rather than just another apartment building. Each of the five apartments has its own personality while sharing the warmth and charm of the larger property. Large windows bring in plenty of natural light, creating bright and inviting spaces throughout the building. Free On-Site Laundry Forget about hauling your laundry to a laundromat. Free shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site within the building. The laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, and there is no additional charge to use it. Off-Street Parking Included Living Downtown doesn't have to mean fighting for street parking every night. Off-street parking is included at 232 S Geneva Street, providing residents with the convenience of parking directly at the property. That's an especially valuable amenity for a Downtown Ithaca location. Live Near the Ithaca Commons One of the biggest advantages of 232 S Geneva is its location. The property is just blocks from the Ithaca Commons and the heart of Downtown Ithaca, putting restaurants, coffee shops, shopping, nightlife, entertainment, and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Walk Downtown for dinner. Meet friends for coffee. Head to the Commons for an event. Enjoy everything Ithaca has to offer without needing to get in your car. Convenient to Both Cornell & Ithaca College 232 S Geneva is also an excellent option for groups with students attending Cornell University, Ithaca College, or a combination of both. Its central Downtown location provides convenient access to both campuses. A bus stop is located on the block, with several additional stops nearby along Clinton, Fayette, and Green Streets, giving residents plenty of options for getting around Ithaca. Pet Friendly Bring your four-legged roommate! Dogs and cats are welcome. Some breed restrictions may apply, so please ask about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: Electricity Gas Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free on-site laundry Off-street parking A Unique Option for Your Group in Downtown Ithaca Finding housing for a large group can be challenging—especially if you want to stay Downtown. At 232 S Geneva Street, five separate apartments give groups the opportunity to stay together while still having the independence and privacy of individual living spaces. Whether you're looking for one apartment or trying to place a much larger group, tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help explore the available combinations. Your Friends. Your Apartments. One Historic Downtown Ithaca Home. Contact us today with your group size to discuss available combinations at 232 S Geneva Street or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: This apartment is the second floor of an up/down duplex and was newly renovated in 2018. There are 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms on each floor. The home features modern finishes like luxury vinyl tiling, stainless steel appliances, and large windows. In the kitchen there are new granite countertops and a dishwasher. The bathrooms are custom-tiled and there is free laundry in the unit. Furnishings include: Large sized beds Writing desks and Chair Closets and Dressers Window Treatments Dining room and living room sets Rent includes landscaping, snow removal and off-street parking. Pet friendly! Dogs and cats allowed. Some breed restrictions apply. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 217 Columbia Street are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located nearby for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home is on a quiet street geared toward both students and young professionals. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail which was built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. This is a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross country skiing and access to this trail is only one block from the home.

ShortDescription: This apartment is the second floor of an up/down duplex and was newly renovated in 2018. There are 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms on each floor. The home features modern finishes like luxury vinyl tiling, stainless steel appliances, and large windows. In the kitchen there are new granite countertops and a dishwasher. The bathrooms are custom-tiled and there is free laundry in the unit. Furnishings include: Large sized beds Writing desks and Chair Closets and Dressers Window Treatments Dining room and living room sets Rent includes landscaping, snow removal and off-street parking. Pet friendly! Dogs and cats allowed. Some breed restrictions apply. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 217 Columbia Street are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located nearby for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home is on a quiet street geared toward both students and young professionals. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail which was built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. This is a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross country skiing and access to this trail is only one block from the home.

ShortDescription: This apartment is the second floor of an up/down duplex and was newly renovated in 2018. There are 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms on each floor. The home features modern finishes like luxury vinyl tiling, stainless steel appliances, and large windows. In the kitchen there are new granite countertops and a dishwasher. The bathrooms are custom-tiled and there is free laundry in the unit. Furnishings include: Large sized beds Writing desks and Chair Closets and Dressers Window Treatments Dining room and living room sets Rent includes landscaping, snow removal and off-street parking. Pet friendly! Dogs and cats allowed. Some breed restrictions apply. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 217 Columbia Street are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located nearby for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home is on a quiet street geared toward both students and young professionals. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail which was built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. This is a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross country skiing and access to this trail is only one block from the home.

ShortDescription: This apartment is the second floor of an up/down duplex and was newly renovated in 2018. There are 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms on each floor. The home features modern finishes like luxury vinyl tiling, stainless steel appliances, and large windows. In the kitchen there are new granite countertops and a dishwasher. The bathrooms are custom-tiled and there is free laundry in the unit. Furnishings include: Large sized beds Writing desks and Chair Closets and Dressers Window Treatments Dining room and living room sets Rent includes landscaping, snow removal and off-street parking. Pet friendly! Dogs and cats allowed. Some breed restrictions apply. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 217 Columbia Street are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located nearby for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home is on a quiet street geared toward both students and young professionals. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail which was built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. This is a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross country skiing and access to this trail is only one block from the home.

ShortDescription: Recently Built South Hill Home - Pet Friendly - Parking & Laundry Included These apartments can be fully-furnished with full size or larger beds, writing desks, dressers, dining/living room sets, and all major appliances. Rent includes landscaping and snow removal. Off-street parking is also available. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 605 S. Aurora are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located directly outside the development for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home borders the rental units of our 607 S. Aurora Street property and are ideal for both undergrad and graduate students. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross-country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. Access to this trail is only one block away!

ShortDescription: Recently Built South Hill Home - Pet Friendly - Parking & Laundry Included These apartments can be fully-furnished with full size or larger beds, writing desks, dressers, dining/living room sets, and all major appliances. Rent includes landscaping and snow removal. Off-street parking is also available. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 605 S. Aurora are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located directly outside the development for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home borders the rental units of our 607 S. Aurora Street property and are ideal for both undergrad and graduate students. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross-country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. Access to this trail is only one block away!

ShortDescription: Recently Built South Hill Home - Pet Friendly - Parking & Laundry Included These apartments can be fully-furnished with full size or larger beds, writing desks, dressers, dining/living room sets, and all major appliances. Rent includes landscaping and snow removal. Off-street parking is also available. Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. The units at 605 S. Aurora are located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. A bus stop is located directly outside the development for easy access to both IC and Cornell’s Campus and downtown. This home borders the rental units of our 607 S. Aurora Street property and are ideal for both undergrad and graduate students. Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking and cross-country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. Access to this trail is only one block away!

The living room has a sectional along with dining table and chairs. In 2020 the home was renovated with lots of new upgrades including a new roof, a new boiler that is highly efficient, keeping your heating cost down and on-demand hot water so you never run out of hot water. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity! Pets okay! Ask about our pet policy! Tenant pays utilities and wifi. Landlord pays snow removal, lawn care

ShortDescription: 8 Bedrooms. 4 Apartments. 4 Kitchens. Bring Your Group. Looking for housing for a group of friends near Cornell University and Collegetown? Welcome to 110 Stewart Avenue, a renovated multi-family property offering 8 total bedrooms across four separate apartments. With a mix of studio, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, 110 Stewart gives groups the flexibility to live together at the same property without everyone having to share one large apartment. Whether you're looking for housing for 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or up to 8 people, contact us with your group size and we'll help explore the available apartment combinations. 8 Bedrooms Across 4 Separate Apartments 110 Stewart Avenue includes: One Studio Apartment One 3-Bedroom Apartment Two 2-Bedroom Apartments Altogether, the property provides: 8 total bedrooms 4 bathrooms 4 separate kitchens 4 individual apartments This combination gives groups a level of flexibility that's difficult to find in a conventional rental. Have 3 people? Start with the 3-bedroom. Have 4? Ask about combining the two 2-bedroom apartments. Have 5? A 3-bedroom and 2-bedroom could keep everyone together. Have 7? Combine the 3-bedroom and both 2-bedrooms. Have all 8? Depending on availability, your group may be able to occupy the entire property. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 110 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. Our multi-unit properties can create options for groups that don't fit neatly into the standard 3-, 4-, or 5-bedroom apartment search. Four Apartments Means Four Kitchens One of the biggest advantages of 110 Stewart Avenue is the ability to keep your group together without having to share everything. A group occupying multiple apartments can have access to: Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Separate living areas More refrigerator and cabinet space More privacy between roommates Separate spaces for studying or relaxing Friends living right upstairs, downstairs, or next door And if your group occupies the entire property, that's 8 bedrooms with four separate kitchens and four bathrooms. Live with your friends while still having your own space. Renovated in 2020 110 Stewart Avenue was renovated in 2020, bringing fresh, contemporary finishes to the apartments. The kitchens feature: Stainless steel appliances Granite countertops Freshly painted cabinetry Modern finishes Functional layouts The updated kitchens complement the property's spacious bedrooms and comfortable living areas. Spacious Bedrooms & Living Areas Inside the apartments, you'll find generously sized bedrooms, large living spaces, and spacious closets. The layouts provide residents with room to study, relax, entertain, and enjoy their home outside of the bedroom. For groups occupying multiple units, having several separate living areas also provides plenty of flexibility for how your friends use the property. Furnished Apartments Moving into your new place is easier when you don't have to furnish every bedroom from scratch. Each apartment at 110 Stewart Avenue comes furnished with bedroom essentials including: Bed Bed frame Desk Desk chair Dresser Furnishings are already waiting for you, making this an especially convenient option for students. Free On-Site Laundry Free shared laundry is available in the building. The laundry is on-site and shared rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without needing to leave the property or pay for an off-site laundromat. Off-Street Parking Available Off-street parking is available at 110 Stewart Avenue. Parking can be especially valuable in this area, so ask about current availability, terms, and any applicable fees. Excellent Location Near Collegetown & Downtown Ithaca 110 Stewart Avenue provides convenient access to both Collegetown and Downtown Ithaca, making it a great option for Cornell students and anyone who wants easy access to the city's restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and nightlife. Residents can easily reach: Cornell University Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants and coffee shops Shopping Entertainment Public transportation The location gives you the convenience of accessing both campus life and Downtown Ithaca. Six Mile Creek & South Hill Nearby The property is located less than approximately half a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which provides pedestrian access toward Ithaca's South Hill neighborhood. It's another great benefit of living in this part of Ithaca—you can remain convenient to Cornell and Downtown while having easy access to some of the area's outdoor spaces. Convenient Bus Access A covered bus stop is located nearby at the top of Quarry Street, giving residents another convenient transportation option for getting around Ithaca and to Cornell. Walk, bike, drive, or take the bus depending on your schedule. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 110 Stewart Avenue is pet friendly. Some breed restrictions may apply. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: NYSEG – gas and electricity Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free shared on-site laundry Off-street parking is also available. Looking for Housing for 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8 People? You don't necessarily need to find one giant apartment to keep your group together. At 110 Stewart Avenue, the combination of a studio, 3-bedroom, and two 2-bedroom apartments creates flexible possibilities for groups of different sizes. Have 4 people? 5? 6? 7? All 8? Tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help determine the best available combination. 8 Bedrooms. 4 Apartments. 4 Kitchens. One Stewart Avenue Property. Contact us today with your group size to discuss availability at 110 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.
