ShortDescription: 8 Bedrooms. 4 Apartments. 4 Kitchens. Bring Your Group. Looking for housing for a group of friends near Cornell University and Collegetown? Welcome to 110 Stewart Avenue, a renovated multi-family property offering 8 total bedrooms across four separate apartments. With a mix of studio, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, 110 Stewart gives groups the flexibility to live together at the same property without everyone having to share one large apartment. Whether you're looking for housing for 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or up to 8 people, contact us with your group size and we'll help explore the available apartment combinations. 8 Bedrooms Across 4 Separate Apartments 110 Stewart Avenue includes: One Studio Apartment One 3-Bedroom Apartment Two 2-Bedroom Apartments Altogether, the property provides: 8 total bedrooms 4 bathrooms 4 separate kitchens 4 individual apartments This combination gives groups a level of flexibility that's difficult to find in a conventional rental. Have 3 people? Start with the 3-bedroom. Have 4? Ask about combining the two 2-bedroom apartments. Have 5? A 3-bedroom and 2-bedroom could keep everyone together. Have 7? Combine the 3-bedroom and both 2-bedrooms. Have all 8? Depending on availability, your group may be able to occupy the entire property. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 110 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. Our multi-unit properties can create options for groups that don't fit neatly into the standard 3-, 4-, or 5-bedroom apartment search. Four Apartments Means Four Kitchens One of the biggest advantages of 110 Stewart Avenue is the ability to keep your group together without having to share everything. A group occupying multiple apartments can have access to: Multiple kitchens Multiple bathrooms Separate living areas More refrigerator and cabinet space More privacy between roommates Separate spaces for studying or relaxing Friends living right upstairs, downstairs, or next door And if your group occupies the entire property, that's 8 bedrooms with four separate kitchens and four bathrooms. Live with your friends while still having your own space. Renovated in 2020 110 Stewart Avenue was renovated in 2020, bringing fresh, contemporary finishes to the apartments. The kitchens feature: Stainless steel appliances Granite countertops Freshly painted cabinetry Modern finishes Functional layouts The updated kitchens complement the property's spacious bedrooms and comfortable living areas. Spacious Bedrooms & Living Areas Inside the apartments, you'll find generously sized bedrooms, large living spaces, and spacious closets. The layouts provide residents with room to study, relax, entertain, and enjoy their home outside of the bedroom. For groups occupying multiple units, having several separate living areas also provides plenty of flexibility for how your friends use the property. Furnished Apartments Moving into your new place is easier when you don't have to furnish every bedroom from scratch. Each apartment at 110 Stewart Avenue comes furnished with bedroom essentials including: Bed Bed frame Desk Desk chair Dresser Furnishings are already waiting for you, making this an especially convenient option for students. Free On-Site Laundry Free shared laundry is available in the building. The laundry is on-site and shared rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without needing to leave the property or pay for an off-site laundromat. Off-Street Parking Available Off-street parking is available at 110 Stewart Avenue. Parking can be especially valuable in this area, so ask about current availability, terms, and any applicable fees. Excellent Location Near Collegetown & Downtown Ithaca 110 Stewart Avenue provides convenient access to both Collegetown and Downtown Ithaca, making it a great option for Cornell students and anyone who wants easy access to the city's restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and nightlife. Residents can easily reach: Cornell University Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants and coffee shops Shopping Entertainment Public transportation The location gives you the convenience of accessing both campus life and Downtown Ithaca. Six Mile Creek & South Hill Nearby The property is located less than approximately half a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which provides pedestrian access toward Ithaca's South Hill neighborhood. It's another great benefit of living in this part of Ithaca—you can remain convenient to Cornell and Downtown while having easy access to some of the area's outdoor spaces. Convenient Bus Access A covered bus stop is located nearby at the top of Quarry Street, giving residents another convenient transportation option for getting around Ithaca and to Cornell. Walk, bike, drive, or take the bus depending on your schedule. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 110 Stewart Avenue is pet friendly. Some breed restrictions may apply. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities & Property Services Tenant is responsible for: NYSEG – gas and electricity Water/sewer Wi-Fi Landlord provides: Lawn care Snow removal Free shared on-site laundry Off-street parking is also available. Looking for Housing for 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8 People? You don't necessarily need to find one giant apartment to keep your group together. At 110 Stewart Avenue, the combination of a studio, 3-bedroom, and two 2-bedroom apartments creates flexible possibilities for groups of different sizes. Have 4 people? 5? 6? 7? All 8? Tell us how many bedrooms you need and we'll help determine the best available combination. 8 Bedrooms. 4 Apartments. 4 Kitchens. One Stewart Avenue Property. Contact us today with your group size to discuss availability at 110 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca.

ShortDescription: This 4-bedroom apartment was extensively renovated in the summer of 2021. The apartment features all new flooring, furnishings, and contemporary finishes. Enjoy modern amenities like in-unit laundry and stylish new lighting fixtures. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances. The bathrooms feature new vanities and custom tiling. The home is available fully-furnished with a couch, dining room table, and chairs. Beds, desks, and dressers are also provided at no extra cost. Rent includes furnishings, lawn care, snow removal, and laundry. Off-street parking also available. This home is in an excellent location convenient to Cornell’s Campus, Collegetown, and The Ithaca Commons. (Walk to any of these locations is ten minutes or less.) The property is less than ¼ of a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which connects to Ithaca South Hill. There is a covered bus stop at the top of Quarry Street. Pet friendly! Cats and dogs allowed. Some breed restrictions apply.

ShortDescription: This 4-bedroom apartment was extensively renovated in the summer of 2021. The apartment features all new flooring, furnishings, and contemporary finishes. Enjoy modern amenities like in-unit laundry and stylish new lighting fixtures. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances. The bathrooms feature new vanities and custom tiling. The home is available fully-furnished with a couch, dining room table, and chairs. Beds, desks, and dressers are also provided at no extra cost. Rent includes furnishings, lawn care, snow removal, and laundry. Off-street parking also available. This home is in an excellent location convenient to Cornell’s Campus, Collegetown, and The Ithaca Commons. (Walk to any of these locations is ten minutes or less.) The property is less than ¼ of a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which connects to Ithaca South Hill. There is a covered bus stop at the top of Quarry Street. Pet friendly! Cats and dogs allowed. Some breed restrictions apply.

ShortDescription: This 4-bedroom apartment was extensively renovated in the summer of 2021. The apartment features all new flooring, furnishings, and contemporary finishes. Enjoy modern amenities like in-unit laundry and stylish new lighting fixtures. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances. The bathrooms feature new vanities and custom tiling. The home is available fully-furnished with a couch, dining room table, and chairs. Beds, desks, and dressers are also provided at no extra cost. Rent includes furnishings, lawn care, snow removal, and laundry. Off-street parking also available. This home is in an excellent location convenient to Cornell’s Campus, Collegetown, and The Ithaca Commons. (Walk to any of these locations is ten minutes or less.) The property is less than ¼ of a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which connects to Ithaca South Hill. There is a covered bus stop at the top of Quarry Street. Pet friendly! Cats and dogs allowed. Some breed restrictions apply.

ShortDescription: This 4-bedroom apartment was extensively renovated in the summer of 2021. The apartment features all new flooring, furnishings, and contemporary finishes. Enjoy modern amenities like in-unit laundry and stylish new lighting fixtures. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops and new stainless steel appliances. The bathrooms feature new vanities and custom tiling. The home is available fully-furnished with a couch, dining room table, and chairs. Beds, desks, and dressers are also provided at no extra cost. Rent includes furnishings, lawn care, snow removal, and laundry. Off-street parking also available. This home is in an excellent location convenient to Cornell’s Campus, Collegetown, and The Ithaca Commons. (Walk to any of these locations is ten minutes or less.) The property is less than ¼ of a mile from Six Mile Creek and the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge, which connects to Ithaca South Hill. There is a covered bus stop at the top of Quarry Street. Pet friendly! Cats and dogs allowed. Some breed restrictions apply.

ShortDescription: This 4br 2ba apartment is bright, spacious, and close to IC, downtown and the commons, and is two short blocks away from the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge that crosses the gorge to Cornell! Fully furnished with beds, dressers, desks, couch, and window treatments. In-unit, private laundry. It also has off street parking! Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. Located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants, and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. Off-street parking available and a nearby bus stop for an easy commute to both IC and Cornell campuses or downtown. This is a beautiful place to call home for the summer! Pets are welcome! Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking, and cross country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. ShortDescription: This 4br 2ba apartment is bright, spacious, and close to IC, downtown and the commons, and is two short blocks away from the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge that crosses the gorge to Cornell! Fully furnished with beds, dressers, desks, couch, and window treatments. In-unit, private laundry. It also has off street parking! Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. Located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants, and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. Off-street parking available and a nearby bus stop for an easy commute to both IC and Cornell campuses or downtown. This is a beautiful place to call home for the summer! Pets are welcome! Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking, and cross country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. ShortDescription: This 4br 2ba apartment is bright, spacious, and close to IC, downtown and the commons, and is two short blocks away from the Columbia Street Pedestrian Bridge that crosses the gorge to Cornell! Fully furnished with beds, dressers, desks, couch, and window treatments. In-unit, private laundry. It also has off street parking! Ithaca’s South Hill neighborhood is made up of a mix of both families and students. Located halfway between Ithaca College and the shops, restaurants, and bars found on the Ithaca Commons. Off-street parking available and a nearby bus stop for an easy commute to both IC and Cornell campuses or downtown. This is a beautiful place to call home for the summer! Pets are welcome! Other features of this neighborhood include the South Hill Recreation Trail, a beautiful, flat trail for biking, running, hiking, and cross country skiing, built on the abandoned railroad bed of the Cayuga and Susquehanna Railroad. These fully furnished apartments pair a fresh, modern interior with the easy, walkable charm of Fall Creek, so you can move in with just your suitcase and start living. Each residence features white marbled quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a full-size stove and refrigerator, and brand-new flooring throughout, giving every room a clean, bright feel you’ll be happy to come home to. Life here is simple and convenient. Off-street parking takes the hassle out of Ithaca winters, and the neighborhood puts local cafés, parks, and the gorges within easy reach, with Cornell and downtown a short trip away. With only a handful of homes at the property, you’ll enjoy a quieter, more personal setting backed by the responsive, local management of Modern Living Rentals. Schedule your tour today and see why Fall Creek residents rarely want to leave. ShortDescription: 404 University Avenue – Renovated & Fully Furnished Apartments Near Cornell Looking for housing for your group near Cornell? 404 University Avenue offers flexible options for groups of different sizes, with multiple apartments available within the same building. Whether you're searching for a single bedroom, an apartment for three, or trying to accommodate a larger group of friends together, ask us about available combinations! Property Layout 404 University Avenue consists of five separate apartments: Four 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments One 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment 13 total bedrooms throughout the building Depending on availability, we can work with groups looking for any number of bedrooms by combining apartments within the same property. This is a great option for larger groups who want to live together or in the same building while still having the privacy and convenience of separate apartments. Recently Renovated The property was extensively renovated in 2021 with modern finishes throughout. Apartments feature: Quartz countertops Stainless steel appliances Updated cabinetry Custom bathroom tilework Bright, spacious kitchens Comfortable living and common areas With two full bathrooms in each of the 3-bedroom apartments, the layouts are especially convenient for roommates. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready Each apartment comes fully furnished, including: Full-size beds and bed frames Desks and desk chairs Living room furniture Smart TVs Dining tables and chairs Simply bring your personal belongings and settle in. Excellent Location Near Cornell Located at 404 University Avenue, the property offers an excellent location for Cornell students looking for convenient access to campus and Collegetown. Live close to classes, dining, shopping, coffee shops, and everything the Cornell community has to offer. Have a Larger Group? Ask Us! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! Ask about our pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities Tenant pays: Gas, electricity, water/sewer, and Wi-Fi. Landlord provides: Snow removal and lawn care. Contact us with your group size and we'll help determine the best available combination at 404 University Avenue.

ShortDescription: 404 University Avenue – Renovated & Fully Furnished Apartments Near Cornell Looking for housing for your group near Cornell? 404 University Avenue offers flexible options for groups of different sizes, with multiple apartments available within the same building. Whether you're searching for a single bedroom, an apartment for three, or trying to accommodate a larger group of friends together, ask us about available combinations! Property Layout 404 University Avenue consists of five separate apartments: Four 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments One 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment 13 total bedrooms throughout the building Depending on availability, we can work with groups looking for any number of bedrooms by combining apartments within the same property. This is a great option for larger groups who want to live together or in the same building while still having the privacy and convenience of separate apartments. Recently Renovated The property was extensively renovated in 2021 with modern finishes throughout. Apartments feature: Quartz countertops Stainless steel appliances Updated cabinetry Custom bathroom tilework Bright, spacious kitchens Comfortable living and common areas With two full bathrooms in each of the 3-bedroom apartments, the layouts are especially convenient for roommates. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready Each apartment comes fully furnished, including: Full-size beds and bed frames Desks and desk chairs Living room furniture Smart TVs Dining tables and chairs Simply bring your personal belongings and settle in. Excellent Location Near Cornell Located at 404 University Avenue, the property offers an excellent location for Cornell students looking for convenient access to campus and Collegetown. Live close to classes, dining, shopping, coffee shops, and everything the Cornell community has to offer. Have a Larger Group? Ask Us! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! Ask about our pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities Tenant pays: Gas, electricity, water/sewer, and Wi-Fi. Landlord provides: Snow removal and lawn care. Contact us with your group size and we'll help determine the best available combination at 404 University Avenue.

Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! ShortDescription: 404 University Avenue – Renovated & Fully Furnished Apartments Near Cornell Looking for housing for your group near Cornell? 404 University Avenue offers flexible options for groups of different sizes, with multiple apartments available within the same building. Whether you're searching for a single bedroom, an apartment for three, or trying to accommodate a larger group of friends together, ask us about available combinations! Property Layout 404 University Avenue consists of five separate apartments: Four 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments One 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment 13 total bedrooms throughout the building Depending on availability, we can work with groups looking for any number of bedrooms by combining apartments within the same property. This is a great option for larger groups who want to live together or in the same building while still having the privacy and convenience of separate apartments. Recently Renovated The property was extensively renovated in 2021 with modern finishes throughout. Apartments feature: Quartz countertops Stainless steel appliances Updated cabinetry Custom bathroom tilework Bright, spacious kitchens Comfortable living and common areas With two full bathrooms in each of the 3-bedroom apartments, the layouts are especially convenient for roommates. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready Each apartment comes fully furnished, including: Full-size beds and bed frames Desks and desk chairs Living room furniture Smart TVs Dining tables and chairs Simply bring your personal belongings and settle in. Excellent Location Near Cornell Located at 404 University Avenue, the property offers an excellent location for Cornell students looking for convenient access to campus and Collegetown. Live close to classes, dining, shopping, coffee shops, and everything the Cornell community has to offer. Have a Larger Group? Ask Us! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! Ask about our pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities Tenant pays: Gas, electricity, water/sewer, and Wi-Fi. Landlord provides: Snow removal and lawn care. Contact us with your group size and we'll help determine the best available combination at 404 University Avenue.

ShortDescription: 404 University Avenue – Renovated & Fully Furnished Apartments Near Cornell Looking for housing for your group near Cornell? 404 University Avenue offers flexible options for groups of different sizes, with multiple apartments available within the same building. Whether you're searching for a single bedroom, an apartment for three, or trying to accommodate a larger group of friends together, ask us about available combinations! Property Layout 404 University Avenue consists of five separate apartments: Four 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments One 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment 13 total bedrooms throughout the building Depending on availability, we can work with groups looking for any number of bedrooms by combining apartments within the same property. This is a great option for larger groups who want to live together or in the same building while still having the privacy and convenience of separate apartments. Recently Renovated The property was extensively renovated in 2021 with modern finishes throughout. Apartments feature: Quartz countertops Stainless steel appliances Updated cabinetry Custom bathroom tilework Bright, spacious kitchens Comfortable living and common areas With two full bathrooms in each of the 3-bedroom apartments, the layouts are especially convenient for roommates. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready Each apartment comes fully furnished, including: Full-size beds and bed frames Desks and desk chairs Living room furniture Smart TVs Dining tables and chairs Simply bring your personal belongings and settle in. Excellent Location Near Cornell Located at 404 University Avenue, the property offers an excellent location for Cornell students looking for convenient access to campus and Collegetown. Live close to classes, dining, shopping, coffee shops, and everything the Cornell community has to offer. Have a Larger Group? Ask Us! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! Ask about our pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities Tenant pays: Gas, electricity, water/sewer, and Wi-Fi. Landlord provides: Snow removal and lawn care. Contact us with your group size and we'll help determine the best available combination at 404 University Avenue.

ShortDescription: 404 University Avenue – Renovated & Fully Furnished Apartments Near Cornell Looking for housing for your group near Cornell? 404 University Avenue offers flexible options for groups of different sizes, with multiple apartments available within the same building. Whether you're searching for a single bedroom, an apartment for three, or trying to accommodate a larger group of friends together, ask us about available combinations! Property Layout 404 University Avenue consists of five separate apartments: Four 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments One 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment 13 total bedrooms throughout the building Depending on availability, we can work with groups looking for any number of bedrooms by combining apartments within the same property. This is a great option for larger groups who want to live together or in the same building while still having the privacy and convenience of separate apartments. Recently Renovated The property was extensively renovated in 2021 with modern finishes throughout. Apartments feature: Quartz countertops Stainless steel appliances Updated cabinetry Custom bathroom tilework Bright, spacious kitchens Comfortable living and common areas With two full bathrooms in each of the 3-bedroom apartments, the layouts are especially convenient for roommates. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready Each apartment comes fully furnished, including: Full-size beds and bed frames Desks and desk chairs Living room furniture Smart TVs Dining tables and chairs Simply bring your personal belongings and settle in. Excellent Location Near Cornell Located at 404 University Avenue, the property offers an excellent location for Cornell students looking for convenient access to campus and Collegetown. Live close to classes, dining, shopping, coffee shops, and everything the Cornell community has to offer. Have a Larger Group? Ask Us! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 404 University Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Pet Friendly Pets are welcome! Ask about our pet policy, requirements, and applicable fees. Utilities Tenant pays: Gas, electricity, water/sewer, and Wi-Fi. Landlord provides: Snow removal and lawn care. Contact us with your group size and we'll help determine the best available combination at 404 University Avenue.

ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home.
