ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. Contact us today to discuss availability at 601 E State Street – Building 2 or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. Be Among the First to Call 601 E State Street – Building 2 Home. Don’t miss out on the opportunity to make this gorgeous apartment your new home. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. Convenient On-Site Laundry Shared laundry facilities are conveniently located on-site at the property. Laundry is on-site rather than located inside each individual apartment, giving residents convenient access without having to travel to an off-site laundromat. An Incredible Location Near Cornell 601 E State Street sits in an outstanding location near the intersection of Stewart Avenue and East State Street, putting residents in an excellent position between Cornell, Collegetown, and Downtown Ithaca. The property is approximately five blocks from Cornell's West Campus, making it easy to get to campus while still enjoying the independence of off-campus living. Residents have convenient access to: Cornell University Cornell West Campus Collegetown Downtown Ithaca The Ithaca Commons Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Entertainment and nightlife Six Mile Creek area You're close to campus without giving up convenient access to Downtown. Pet Friendly Your four-legged roommate is welcome too! 601 E State Street is pet friendly. Ask us about our current pet policy, requirements, restrictions, and applicable fees. Maintenance-Free Exterior Spend your time enjoying Ithaca—not worrying about maintaining the property. Our property management team handles: Landscaping Lawn care Snow removal Looking for Brand-New Housing for 6, 9, 12, 15 or 18 People? This is where 601 E State Street – Building 2 really stands apart. Finding a brand-new 12-, 15-, or 18-bedroom house near Cornell is nearly impossible. You don't need one. Your group can potentially combine multiple brand-new 3-bedroom apartments within the same building. You get your friends nearby while each smaller roommate group has its own kitchen, living room, bathroom, and apartment. 18 Bedrooms. 6 Apartments. 6 Kitchens. Brand-New Construction. Whether you're looking for one apartment or potentially the entire building, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the available options. ShortDescription: 18 Bedrooms. 6 Brand-New Apartments. One Incredible Collegetown Property. Be among the first to live here. Welcome to 601 E State Street – Building 2, one of the newest additions to the Modern Living Rentals portfolio and an incredible opportunity for groups looking for brand-new housing near Cornell University. This thoughtfully designed three-story new-construction building features six separate 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 18 bedrooms. Everything is new. The kitchens. The bathrooms. The flooring. The appliances. The HVAC. The windows. The furnishings. Whether you're looking for one 3-bedroom apartment or trying to keep a group of 6, 9, 12, 15, or even 18 friends together, 601 E State Street – Building 2 offers an exceptionally flexible group-housing opportunity. BRAND-NEW CONSTRUCTION This isn't an older Ithaca apartment with a few cosmetic upgrades. 601 E State Street – Building 2 is brand-new construction designed from the ground up for modern living. Residents can enjoy the character and energy of one of Ithaca's most established neighborhoods while coming home to a completely new apartment. No decades-old kitchen. No outdated bathroom. No ancient heating system. You get to be among the first residents to call these apartments home. 18 Bedrooms Across 6 Matching Apartments Building 2 consists of: 6 separate apartments 3 bedrooms per apartment 1 bathroom per apartment 18 total bedrooms 6 kitchens 6 living and dining spaces Three stories of brand-new housing The matching 3-bedroom layouts make this building especially easy to configure for groups. 3 people: One apartment 6 people: Two apartments 9 people: Three apartments 12 people: Four apartments 15 people: Five apartments 18 people: Take all six, subject to availability. Your friends can live upstairs, downstairs, or right next door without everyone having to squeeze into one enormous apartment. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 601 E State Street or one of our many other incredible properties. Don't see a traditional apartment advertised for your exact group size? Ask us anyway. With six separate apartments in Building 2—as well as additional housing at the 601 E State Street property—we have tremendous flexibility for groups looking to stay close to one another. Six Apartments Means Six Kitchens For a large group, separate apartments can be a major advantage over one giant house. A group occupying multiple units at 601 E State Street – Building 2 can enjoy: Multiple full kitchens Multiple refrigerators Multiple dishwashers Separate living and dining areas More cabinet and countertop space More privacy between roommates Separate areas for studying and relaxing Friends living just steps away If your group takes the entire building, that's 18 bedrooms with six separate kitchens and six separate common areas. Live together without having to share everything. Open-Concept Living Each apartment has been thoughtfully designed around an open-concept floor plan connecting the kitchen, dining, and living spaces. Large, energy-efficient windows bring plenty of natural light into the apartments, creating bright, inviting spaces for everyday living. Whether you're cooking, studying, watching a movie, or hanging out with roommates, the common area is designed to feel open, modern, and comfortable. Beautiful Brand-New Kitchens The kitchens are a centerpiece of these apartments. Each kitchen features a complete suite of brand-new stainless steel appliances, including: Refrigerator/freezer Range and oven Microwave Dishwasher Modern cabinetry Contemporary fixtures Beautiful countertops Island seating Everything is new and designed to create a clean, modern space for cooking, dining, and entertaining. Modern Furnished Living Rooms The living rooms are designed for both comfort and style and come furnished for residents. Features include: Modern sofa Wall-mounted Smart TV LED fireplace Dining space Contemporary furnishings Open connection to the kitchen Move in and start enjoying your apartment without having to furnish an entire living room from scratch. Beautiful Custom Bathrooms Each apartment includes a brand-new bathroom featuring contemporary finishes and thoughtful details. Bathroom features include: Custom porcelain tile Bathtub with glass enclosure Modern shower system Shower head Body sprayers Handheld wand Contemporary vanity LED backlit mirror These aren't typical student-housing bathrooms—they were designed to complement the modern finish level throughout the rest of the apartment. Fully Furnished Bedrooms Every bedroom comes ready for move-in. Bedroom furnishings include: Full-size bed frame Premium memory foam mattress Armoire or closet Desk Task chair No need to buy a mattress, haul a bed frame through Ithaca, or figure out where you're going to store furniture after graduation. Individual Heating & Air Conditioning Stay comfortable through Ithaca summers and winters. The building features modern mini-split HVAC systems providing heating and air conditioning, giving residents far more control over their comfort than traditional older heating systems. Enjoy air conditioning in the summer and efficient heat during the winter. High-Speed Fiber Internet The property offers access to high-speed fiber-optic internet, ideal for studying, streaming, gaming, video calls, and everyday use. For a house full of Cornell students and connected devices, fast and reliable internet capability is an important advantage. The Commons with local shops and restaurants start right out your door. You'll find a variety of eateries, boutiques and late night hangout spots. This location is perfect for students, young professionals, or anyone looking for efficient living in a prime location. Comes fully furnished with double size bed frame and mattress. Couch and dining room table with chairs. Updated kitchenette with stove/oven and refrigerator. LED vanity light in bathroom.

The Commons with local shops and restaurants start right out your door. You'll find a variety of eateries, boutiques and late night hangout spots. This location is perfect for students, young professionals, or anyone looking for efficient living in a prime location. Comes fully furnished with double size bed frame and mattress. Couch and dining room table with chairs. Updated kitchenette with stove/oven and refrigerator. LED vanity light in bathroom.

The Commons with local shops and restaurants start right out your door. You'll find a variety of eateries, boutiques and late night hangout spots. This location is perfect for students, young professionals, or anyone looking for efficient living in a prime location. Comes fully furnished with double size bed frame and mattress. Couch and dining room table with chairs. Updated kitchenette with stove/oven and refrigerator. LED vanity light in bathroom.

The Commons with local shops and restaurants start right out your door. You'll find a variety of eateries, boutiques and late night hangout spots. This location is perfect for students, young professionals, or anyone looking for efficient living in a prime location. Comes fully furnished with double size bed frame and mattress. Couch and dining room table with chairs. Updated kitchenette with stove/oven and refrigerator. LED vanity light in bathroom.

ShortDescription: This building at 200 Highland Ave was built during the Summer of 2024. This property will feature an historic 3 story building that will be fully renovated along with a brand new building designed to compliment the existing building. The original building with have a 6 bed / 2 bath unit and a 5 bed / 3 bath unit, each apartment will have in-unit laundry. The new building will have two 5 bed / 2 bath units and a 3 bed / 1 bath with a shared laundry area. The apartment in this listing is for the 3 bed 1 bath unit located in the NEW house. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features all new kitchens, upgraded bathrooms, new flooring and remodeled living and bedroom areas. Enjoy this home's classic charm blended with modern amenities like custom tile baths, LED vanity mirrors, smart lights and digital door access. The kitchens feature a full suite of new stainless steel appliances, wood cabinets, and quartz countertops. Common areas feature new furnishings including wall-mounted flat screen TVs and space for living and dining accordingly. Additional Furnishings include a couch, dining room table and chairs or kitchen counter seating, full size bed frame and mattress, desks and desk chair, and closet and dressers or large armoire in each bedroom. Our apartments are pet friendly. Some breed restrictions apply. Super location right next to Cornell's North Campus and a short walk to Main Campus. Landlord provides landscaping and snow removal services. Tenants are responsible for all utilities and internet expenses. https://***.******.***/c_200_highland_ave_ithaca_ny/

ShortDescription: This building at 200 Highland Ave was built during the Summer of 2024. This property will feature an historic 3 story building that will be fully renovated along with a brand new building designed to compliment the existing building. The original building with have a 6 bed / 2 bath unit and a 5 bed / 3 bath unit, each apartment will have in-unit laundry. The new building will have two 5 bed / 2 bath units and a 3 bed / 1 bath with a shared laundry area. The apartment in this listing is for the 3 bed 1 bath unit located in the NEW house. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features all new kitchens, upgraded bathrooms, new flooring and remodeled living and bedroom areas. Enjoy this home's classic charm blended with modern amenities like custom tile baths, LED vanity mirrors, smart lights and digital door access. The kitchens feature a full suite of new stainless steel appliances, wood cabinets, and quartz countertops. Common areas feature new furnishings including wall-mounted flat screen TVs and space for living and dining accordingly. Additional Furnishings include a couch, dining room table and chairs or kitchen counter seating, full size bed frame and mattress, desks and desk chair, and closet and dressers or large armoire in each bedroom. Our apartments are pet friendly. Some breed restrictions apply. Super location right next to Cornell's North Campus and a short walk to Main Campus. Landlord provides landscaping and snow removal services. Tenants are responsible for all utilities and internet expenses. https://***.******.***/c_200_highland_ave_ithaca_ny/

ShortDescription: This building at 200 Highland Ave was built during the Summer of 2024. This property will feature an historic 3 story building that will be fully renovated along with a brand new building designed to compliment the existing building. The original building with have a 6 bed / 2 bath unit and a 5 bed / 3 bath unit, each apartment will have in-unit laundry. The new building will have two 5 bed / 2 bath units and a 3 bed / 1 bath with a shared laundry area. The apartment in this listing is for the 3 bed 1 bath unit located in the NEW house. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features all new kitchens, upgraded bathrooms, new flooring and remodeled living and bedroom areas. Enjoy this home's classic charm blended with modern amenities like custom tile baths, LED vanity mirrors, smart lights and digital door access. The kitchens feature a full suite of new stainless steel appliances, wood cabinets, and quartz countertops. Common areas feature new furnishings including wall-mounted flat screen TVs and space for living and dining accordingly. Additional Furnishings include a couch, dining room table and chairs or kitchen counter seating, full size bed frame and mattress, desks and desk chair, and closet and dressers or large armoire in each bedroom. Our apartments are pet friendly. Some breed restrictions apply. Super location right next to Cornell's North Campus and a short walk to Main Campus. Landlord provides landscaping and snow removal services. Tenants are responsible for all utilities and internet expenses. https://***.******.***/c_200_highland_ave_ithaca_ny/

This property will feature an historic 3 story building that will be fully renovated along with a brand new building designed to compliment the existing building. The original building with have a 6 bed / 2 bath unit and a 5 bed / 3 bath unit, each apartment will have in-unit laundry. The new building will have two 5 bed / 2 bath units and a 3 bed / 1 bath with a shared laundry area. The apartment in this listing is for the 3 bed 1 bath unit located in the NEW house. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features all new kitchens, upgraded bathrooms, new flooring and remodeled living and bedroom areas. Enjoy this home's classic charm blended with modern amenities like custom tile baths, LED vanity mirrors, smart lights and digital door access. The kitchens feature a full suite of new stainless steel appliances, wood cabinets, and quartz countertops. Common areas feature new furnishings including wall-mounted flat screen TVs and space for living and dining accordingly. Additional Furnishings include a couch, dining room table and chairs or kitchen counter seating, full size bed frame and mattress, desks and desk chair, and closet and dressers or large armoire in each bedroom. Our apartments are pet friendly. Some breed restrictions apply. Super location right next to Cornell's North Campus and a short walk to Main Campus. The open layout seamlessly connects the kitchen to the living area, creating a perfect space for entertaining friends or simply relaxing after a long day. No need to worry about finding a laundromat, as there is coin-operated laundry conveniently located on-site. Additionally, off-street parking is available, ensuring that you always have a place to park your vehicle. The location of 211 Linden Avenue - 19 is truly unbeatable. Situated just moments away from campus, you'll have easy access to all the amenities and activities that Ithaca has to offer. Whether you're exploring the vibrant downtown area, enjoying a hike in one of the nearby parks, or attending a university event, everything is within reach. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make 211 Linden Avenue - 19 your new home. Experience the convenience, comfort, and charm of this furnished apartment in the heart of Ithaca. Contact us today to schedule a tour and see for yourself why this is the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Great location on N. Aurora St. in Fall Creek. 10-min. walk to Ithaca Commons, 15-to-20 mins. to the Cornell Arts Quad, and easy access to buses for other areas of campus or shopping. Fully furnished room, about 200 square feet including storage for rent. Queen poster bed, dresser, bookcase, desk, and ergonomic chair. Lots of storage in two big closets. Good light from 2 large windows. There are 2 other renters in this 4-bedroom, 2-bath home. Preferably for international doctoral students, post-docs, or visiting scholars. Quiet spaces for work, study, and small gatherings of friends. After raising my children in this family home, I have rented from one-to-three bedrooms, as individual rooms with access to the full house and grounds, for most of the past 15 years. Renters have come from four continents and many countries, bringing their cultural and food traditions—Vietnam, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, the Congo, Turkey, India, Colombia, Haiti, Iran, China, and Albania. Some renters stay for 1 to 4 years; others are visiting scholars or faculty at Cornell. I continue to work from the studio space behind the house and have a room in the house, where my partner and I occasionally stay. The advantage of this relationship is that I am on-site almost every day to address questions that come up in transition and any maintenance or repairs. Use the onsite separate studio space (when available), drums, full dining room, living room, and possible shared driveway space. Enjoy the yard, including a lovely garden and decks in the front and back of the house.

ShortDescription: Welcome to the Historic Red Brick Mansion. Become a part of Ithaca’s history when you live in this building, which has been officially designated as an Ithaca Landmark. The house is now configured into five unique apartments and a large parking lot that fits 38 vehicles. Assigned Parking available for an extra fee. All apartments are fully furnished. This fabulous Collegetown location is perfect for Graduate Students—still close to Cornell, yet just outside the main commercial blocks, adding desirable privacy and quietness to an otherwise crowded neighborhood. 12 month leases. Rent includes heat & hot water and furniture.

ShortDescription: Welcome to the Historic Red Brick Mansion. Become a part of Ithaca’s history when you live in this building, which has been officially designated as an Ithaca Landmark. This Italianate Mansion, dating from the 1890s, retains much of its original charm and character, including high ceilings, oak floors and trim, and carved fireplace mantels. The house is now configured into five unique apartments and a large parking lot that fits 38 vehicles. Assigned Parking available for an extra fee. All apartments are fully furnished. This fabulous Collegetown location is perfect for Graduate Students—still close to Cornell, yet just outside the main commercial blocks, adding desirable privacy and quietness to an otherwise crowded neighborhood. 12 month leases. Rent includes heat & hot water and furniture.

ShortDescription: Located in the Heart of Collegetown, 200 feet from Cornell’s entrance and directly across from the Brezzano Family Center. 210 Dryden Road offers comfortable and affordable private apartments and single rooms with an unbeatable location. On Floors 2 and 3 of this house, you will find individual, private single rooms where you have your own bedroom and have access to shared kitchens and bath on each floor. Floor 2 has 7 rooms, 2 bathrooms, kitchen, and washer and dryer for the house, as well as a common room for both floors to use. Floor 3 has 8 rooms, 2 bathrooms and a kitchen. All of the dorm-style single rooms are furnished with a full size bed, dresser, desk and chair, bookshelf, as well as a mini-fridge and fan for your use in the room. Enjoy the convenience of dorm-style living in a premium Central Collegetown location! Many bright rooms with contemporary furniture and modern kitchens including microwaves. 12 month leases. Rent includes heat & hot water and furniture.

ShortDescription: Located in the Heart of Collegetown, 200 feet from Cornell’s entrance and directly across from the Brezzano Family Center. 210 Dryden Road offers comfortable and affordable private apartments and single rooms with an unbeatable location. This large house features 2 and 3 bedroom apartments on first floor, and two floors of shared living options. On Floors 2 and 3 of this house, you will find individual, private single rooms where you have your own bedroom and have access to shared kitchens and bath on each floor. Floor 2 has 7 rooms, 2 bathrooms, kitchen, and washer and dryer for the house, as well as a common room for both floors to use. Floor 3 has 8 rooms, 2 bathrooms and a kitchen. All of the dorm-style single rooms are furnished with a full size bed, dresser, desk and chair, bookshelf, as well as a mini-fridge and fan for your use in the room. Enjoy the convenience of dorm-style living in a premium Central Collegetown location! Many bright rooms with contemporary furniture and modern kitchens including microwaves. 12 month leases. Rent includes heat & hot water and furniture.

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Our two communities come together in the heart of Collegetown to offer the students of Cornell University a safe haven. Located on Summit St., The Lux offers one- through five-bedroom apartment floor plans at the closest convenience to Cornell campus. When combined with elevated amenities including a rooftop terrace, fitness center, and study rooms, The Lux is a community made for your lifestyle of work and play. Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

Just down the road, The Lofts on College Ave. offer chic loft-style, fully-furnished apartments available in one- through four-bedroom floor plans. Between getting moving in the fitness lounge and spending time with friends in the media room, The Lofts is perfect for students craving style and space. Come see for yourself why we're the preferred housing of Cornell Athletics!

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

ShortDescription: Space, Style, and Serenity Welcome to East Pointe Apartments, a luxury townhouse-style community set on 20 scenic acres in Lansing, NY. Offering thoughtfully designed one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes, each residence features private entrances, attached garages, patios or balconies, and high-end finishes throughout. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, clubhouse, dog park, car and dog wash station, outdoor fire pit and BBQ area, and access to nearby walking trails. Ideally located just minutes from downtown Ithaca, Cornell University, and Ithaca College, East Pointe blends modern comfort with a peaceful, wooded setting, creating the perfect place to call home.

Conveniently located near major roads, shopping, top schools, and Cornell University, Triphammer Apartments combines easy access with a peaceful setting, making it the perfect place to call home.

Whether you’re a student, professional, or relocating family, Evergreen Pointe offers the ideal blend of location, luxury, and lifestyle. Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes, including quartz countertops, luxury plank flooring, stainless steel appliances, and open-concept layouts—perfect for comfortable, contemporary living. Enjoy the privacy of attached garages and private entrances, paired with the convenience and community feel of apartment living. Whether you’re a student, professional, or relocating family, Evergreen Pointe offers the ideal blend of location, luxury, and lifestyle. Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes, including quartz countertops, luxury plank flooring, stainless steel appliances, and open-concept layouts—perfect for comfortable, contemporary living. Enjoy the privacy of attached garages and private entrances, paired with the convenience and community feel of apartment living. Whether you’re a student, professional, or relocating family, Evergreen Pointe offers the ideal blend of location, luxury, and lifestyle. Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with high-end finishes, including quartz countertops, luxury plank flooring, stainless steel appliances, and open-concept layouts—perfect for comfortable, contemporary living. Enjoy the privacy of attached garages and private entrances, paired with the convenience and community feel of apartment living. Whether you’re a student, professional, or relocating family, Evergreen Pointe offers the ideal blend of location, luxury, and lifestyle. Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

Enjoy the privacy of attached garages and private entrances, paired with the convenience and community feel of apartment living. Whether you’re a student, professional, or relocating family, Evergreen Pointe offers the ideal blend of location, luxury, and lifestyle. Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

Now leasing – schedule a tour of Evergreen Pointe today and experience premier Ithaca apartment living just minutes from campus and downtown!

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Welcome to Ironworks Ithaca, located in the vibrant city of Ithaca, NY. Our apartments offer a modern and convenient living experience, with a range of amenities designed to enhance your lifestyle. Stay active and fit in our state-of-the-art fitness center or find your inner Zen in our yoga studio. We understand that pets are family too, which is why we provide a pet spa and a pet relief area for your furry friends. Enjoy breathtaking views and fresh air on our green rooftop terrace, perfect for relaxing or socializing with friends. For those who love to explore on two wheels, we offer bicycle storage to keep your bikes safe and secure. Need extra space? And when you need a change of scenery, our resident lounge is the perfect place to unwind and connect with neighbors. At Ironworks Ithaca, we strive to provide a comfortable and enjoyable living experience. Come and discover the perfect apartment for you in the heart of Ithaca, NY.

ShortDescription: Just a short 7 minute drive to Cornell vet campus, this Creekside property set on 5 acres, has two apartments, both featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms within a spacious 1,800 square feet. This home is suitable for those seeking a comfortable living space with essential amenities and is pet friendly with a monthly fee. The downstairs apartment has a private patio and kitchen island. The upstairs apartment features ceramic baths. Both units have private entrances. There's ample space for parking. Dryden Fiber Optic available.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.

ShortDescription: The Ravenwood Apartments, situated just one block from the edge of Cornell's West Campus, offers spacious living accommodations. These fully furnished apartments include everything you need for a comfortable lifestyle, from couches, easy chairs, and coffee tables in the living rooms to desks, dressers, and your choice of single or double beds in the bedrooms. Each apartment features a private entrance, providing an added sense of privacy and convenience. The large kitchens are perfect for cooking and entertaining, ensuring you have plenty of space for all your culinary needs. For those with vehicles, two well-lit parking lots are available to meet most parking requirements. Public transportation is easily accessible with a conveniently located bus stop right out front at the corner of University Ave. and Lake St. This prime location allows for easy commuting and quick access to Cornell University and the surrounding areas. Enjoy the perfect blend of necessary amenities and a convenient location at the Ravenwood Apartments, making it an ideal choice for students and professionals alike.
