ShortDescription: 16 Bedrooms. 8 Bathrooms. 4 Apartments. Steps from Cornell. Have a large group looking for modern housing in the heart of Collegetown? Welcome to 308 Stewart Avenue, a beautifully renovated property featuring four separate 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 16 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms. Rent one apartment for a group of four, combine multiple apartments for a larger group, or—depending on availability—bring up to 16 friends and take the entire property. Best of all, every apartment has its own kitchen, living space, two bathrooms, and full-size in-unit washer and dryer. Four 4-Bedroom / 2-Bathroom Apartments The layout at 308 Stewart Avenue makes putting together a large housing group incredibly simple. The property consists of: 4 separate apartments 4 bedrooms per apartment 2 bathrooms per apartment 16 total bedrooms 8 total bathrooms 4 separate kitchens 4 separate living/common areas Full-size in-unit washer and dryer in every apartment Depending on availability, your group can lease one, two, three, or all four apartments. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 308 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Have 4 people? Take one apartment. Have 8? Two 4-bedroom apartments can keep everyone together. Have 12? Ask about three apartments. Have 16 people? Depending on availability, your group could potentially occupy the entire property. And if your group doesn't fit perfectly into a multiple of four, ask us anyway. We have multiple group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca and can help explore your options. Large-Group Living Without One Giant Apartment Finding quality housing for 12 or 16 people near Cornell can be extremely difficult. At 308 Stewart Avenue, you don't need one enormous apartment. Your group can potentially have: 4 separate kitchens 8 bathrooms 4 separate living rooms 4 sets of in-unit laundry Multiple refrigerators More cabinet and countertop space Separate areas for studying and relaxing More privacy between smaller roommate groups Your friends can be right upstairs, downstairs, or next door while everyone maintains the independence of their own apartment. Beautifully Renovated Modern Interiors These apartments have been extensively renovated with stylish, contemporary finishes that set them apart from the typical Collegetown rental. Apartment features include: Quartz countertops Brand-new stainless steel appliances Modern cabinetry Brushed nickel and brass-inspired finishes Updated laminate flooring Contemporary lighting Beautifully renovated bathrooms Modern fixtures throughout The result is a polished, modern apartment in one of Ithaca's most desirable student locations. Upgraded Bathrooms Each 4-bedroom apartment has two full bathrooms, making the layouts particularly convenient for roommates. Bathroom features include: LED touchscreen mirrors Built-in mirror defoggers Modern shower sprayers Updated fixtures Contemporary finishes For a group occupying the entire building, that's eight full bathrooms for 16 bedrooms. Full-Size In-Unit Laundry in Every Apartment Forget shared basement laundry. Every apartment at 308 Stewart Avenue has its own full-size washer and dryer located directly inside the unit. For a larger group occupying several apartments, this is a huge advantage. Two apartments means two sets of laundry. Three apartments means three. Take all four apartments and your group has four separate sets of full-size washers and dryers. No hauling laundry across the building and no sharing one set of machines with 16 people. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready 308 Stewart Avenue comes fully furnished, making move-in easy for students and larger groups. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed frame and mattress Armoire and/or dresser Desk Desk chair Common-area furnishings include: Couch Chair Kitchen/dining table Seating for four Wall-mounted Smart TV Bring your personal belongings and settle in. Secure Coded Entry 308 Stewart Avenue also offers modern access control for added convenience. The property features: Coded keypad entry at the main building entrance Individual coded keypad entry for each apartment No traditional building key to keep track of, and each individual apartment maintains its own secure access. Prime Collegetown Location Near Cornell 308 Stewart Avenue puts you right in the heart of Collegetown, making it an outstanding location for Cornell students. Enjoy convenient access to: Cornell University Collegetown College Avenue Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Bars and nightlife Campus facilities Downtown Ithaca Live off campus while keeping classes, food, coffee, friends, and everything Collegetown has to offer within easy reach. Perfect for Groups of 4, 8, 12 or 16 Few properties make large-group housing this straightforward. 4 people: One apartment 8 people: Two apartments 12 people: Three apartments 16 people: All four apartments And because every apartment is a 4-bedroom / 2-bathroom, your group gets a consistent living experience throughout the property. Each group of four has its own kitchen, living room, two bathrooms, and in-unit laundry while everyone remains together at the same Stewart Avenue address. Bring the Whole Group to 308 Stewart Avenue Why split your friends between different streets or neighborhoods when you could potentially have everyone in the same building? At 308 Stewart Avenue, groups can enjoy modern finishes, fully furnished bedrooms, secure coded entry, multiple kitchens and bathrooms, and in-unit laundry in every apartment—all in a prime Collegetown location near Cornell. Whether you're looking for one, two, three, or all four apartments, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the best available option. 4 Apartments. 16 Bedrooms. 8 Bathrooms. 4 Sets of In-Unit Laundry. One Collegetown Address. Contact us today with your group size to discuss availability at 308 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. ShortDescription: 16 Bedrooms. 8 Bathrooms. 4 Apartments. Steps from Cornell. Have a large group looking for modern housing in the heart of Collegetown? Welcome to 308 Stewart Avenue, a beautifully renovated property featuring four separate 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments for a combined total of 16 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms. Rent one apartment for a group of four, combine multiple apartments for a larger group, or—depending on availability—bring up to 16 friends and take the entire property. Best of all, every apartment has its own kitchen, living space, two bathrooms, and full-size in-unit washer and dryer. Four 4-Bedroom / 2-Bathroom Apartments The layout at 308 Stewart Avenue makes putting together a large housing group incredibly simple. The property consists of: 4 separate apartments 4 bedrooms per apartment 2 bathrooms per apartment 16 total bedrooms 8 total bathrooms 4 separate kitchens 4 separate living/common areas Full-size in-unit washer and dryer in every apartment Depending on availability, your group can lease one, two, three, or all four apartments. Have a Large Group? We Can Help! Have 4, 5, 6, 7, or more people looking to live near one another? Contact us with your group size and we can discuss available apartment combinations at 308 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other incredible properties. Have 4 people? Take one apartment. Have 8? Two 4-bedroom apartments can keep everyone together. Have 12? Ask about three apartments. Have 16 people? Depending on availability, your group could potentially occupy the entire property. And if your group doesn't fit perfectly into a multiple of four, ask us anyway. We have multiple group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca and can help explore your options. Large-Group Living Without One Giant Apartment Finding quality housing for 12 or 16 people near Cornell can be extremely difficult. At 308 Stewart Avenue, you don't need one enormous apartment. Your group can potentially have: 4 separate kitchens 8 bathrooms 4 separate living rooms 4 sets of in-unit laundry Multiple refrigerators More cabinet and countertop space Separate areas for studying and relaxing More privacy between smaller roommate groups Your friends can be right upstairs, downstairs, or next door while everyone maintains the independence of their own apartment. Beautifully Renovated Modern Interiors These apartments have been extensively renovated with stylish, contemporary finishes that set them apart from the typical Collegetown rental. Apartment features include: Quartz countertops Brand-new stainless steel appliances Modern cabinetry Brushed nickel and brass-inspired finishes Updated laminate flooring Contemporary lighting Beautifully renovated bathrooms Modern fixtures throughout The result is a polished, modern apartment in one of Ithaca's most desirable student locations. Upgraded Bathrooms Each 4-bedroom apartment has two full bathrooms, making the layouts particularly convenient for roommates. Bathroom features include: LED touchscreen mirrors Built-in mirror defoggers Modern shower sprayers Updated fixtures Contemporary finishes For a group occupying the entire building, that's eight full bathrooms for 16 bedrooms. Full-Size In-Unit Laundry in Every Apartment Forget shared basement laundry. Every apartment at 308 Stewart Avenue has its own full-size washer and dryer located directly inside the unit. For a larger group occupying several apartments, this is a huge advantage. Two apartments means two sets of laundry. Three apartments means three. Take all four apartments and your group has four separate sets of full-size washers and dryers. No hauling laundry across the building and no sharing one set of machines with 16 people. Fully Furnished & Move-In Ready 308 Stewart Avenue comes fully furnished, making move-in easy for students and larger groups. Each bedroom includes: Full-size bed frame and mattress Armoire and/or dresser Desk Desk chair Common-area furnishings include: Couch Chair Kitchen/dining table Seating for four Wall-mounted Smart TV Bring your personal belongings and settle in. Secure Coded Entry 308 Stewart Avenue also offers modern access control for added convenience. The property features: Coded keypad entry at the main building entrance Individual coded keypad entry for each apartment No traditional building key to keep track of, and each individual apartment maintains its own secure access. Prime Collegetown Location Near Cornell 308 Stewart Avenue puts you right in the heart of Collegetown, making it an outstanding location for Cornell students. Enjoy convenient access to: Cornell University Collegetown College Avenue Restaurants Coffee shops Shopping Bars and nightlife Campus facilities Downtown Ithaca Live off campus while keeping classes, food, coffee, friends, and everything Collegetown has to offer within easy reach. Perfect for Groups of 4, 8, 12 or 16 Few properties make large-group housing this straightforward. 4 people: One apartment 8 people: Two apartments 12 people: Three apartments 16 people: All four apartments And because every apartment is a 4-bedroom / 2-bathroom, your group gets a consistent living experience throughout the property. Each group of four has its own kitchen, living room, two bathrooms, and in-unit laundry while everyone remains together at the same Stewart Avenue address. Bring the Whole Group to 308 Stewart Avenue Why split your friends between different streets or neighborhoods when you could potentially have everyone in the same building? At 308 Stewart Avenue, groups can enjoy modern finishes, fully furnished bedrooms, secure coded entry, multiple kitchens and bathrooms, and in-unit laundry in every apartment—all in a prime Collegetown location near Cornell. Whether you're looking for one, two, three, or all four apartments, tell us your group size and we'll help explore the best available option. 4 Apartments. 16 Bedrooms. 8 Bathrooms. 4 Sets of In-Unit Laundry. One Collegetown Address. Contact us today with your group size to discuss availability at 308 Stewart Avenue or one of our many other group-friendly properties throughout Ithaca. ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Collegetown’s Premier Address Brand New. Boldly Designed. Brilliantly Located. Step into a lifestyle that rises above the ordinary at The Summit at 201 Oak Avenue, Ithaca’s newest and most sought-after address. Perfectly positioned just steps from Cornell University and overlooking the stunning Cascadilla Gorge, The Summit blends striking modern design with everyday comfort and exceptional convenience. From cozy solo studios to spacious 4-bedroom layouts, each apartment is fully furnished and crafted to impress, with features that make coming home the best part of your day. Your Apartment Includes: A sleek ambient LED fireplace and wall-mounted smart TV, perfect for relaxing nights in A chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and luxe marbled quartz countertops A spa-style bathroom featuring an LED vanity mirror, glass shower doors, and designer finishes Gorgeous LVT flooring and stylish new furnishings throughout Your own in-unit washer and dryer, because convenience should never be a compromise Juliet balconies in select units, with breathtaking views of Cascadilla Gorge and the energy of Collegetown Next-Level Amenities Designed for You: A state-of-the-art fitness center and sauna to power your day and recharge after it A lobby lounge with pool table, plus an entertainment kitchen and gaming lounge for hosting and unwinding Private study pods and a cozy reading lounge for focused work or a quiet escape A dedicated package room, secure bike storage, and lush outdoor greenspace Smartphone-enabled keyless entry and intercom system for seamless, secure access All just steps from campus and Collegetown’s best restaurants, cafés, and culture This isn’t just where you live, it’s where you thrive. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together at The Summit. Now Leasing for August 2027. Lock In Your Spot Before It’s Gone!

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

ShortDescription: Welcome to The Ivy at 325 College Ave, a prime living location in Ithaca, NY. Designed with students in mind, this luxurious apartment community offers a wide range of amenities to elevate your college experience. Whether you are powering through a long study session, finishing a workout, or need a place to relax, it is designed to help you recharge. Tackle long study sessions by yourself or with a group of friends in our private study rooms, and if you feel yourself crashing on a late-night study session, then grab a cup from our 24-hour coffee bar. Once the work is done, enjoy breathtaking views from our rooftop terrace or unwind in the wellness spa and take a breather in the sauna for a total reset. Every apartment is fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, an in-unit washer and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. Grab a bite to eat at the KOKO Korean restaurant after you’ve had a chance to reset and catch up with some friends in the game room. The resident lounge is a perfect spot for socializing, and our mailroom ensures your packages are safe and secure. Experience the best of Ithaca living at The Ivy at 325 College Ave.

This unit has two full bathrooms with tile flooring. The unit is equipped with its own washer and dryer, and fully furnished with a couch, dining table, beds, dressers, desks and desk chairs. Window treatments also provided at no additional cost. This unit comes with a large back porch AND front porch as well as a large shared backyard with a fire pit. This apartment is located on at the South end of Fall Creek just minutes from Cornell Campus, Ithaca College, Downtown and Ithaca Commons. Just a short walk to Ithaca Falls and all the shops and restaurants downtown has to offer! Pets okay! Ask about our pet policy! ShortDescription: Rustic country 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home on 12 acres with access to a clean, beautiful private pond for swimming and fishing. Enjoy nature! You get country living here, but you're still very close to shopping and dining. Pet-friendly! (add'l security deposit for dogs.) Spectrum fast wi-fi included, cable-TV available. 14-minute drive to Cornell University; 7-minutes to Ithaca College; 10 minutes to downtown and Wegmans grocery store. Suitable for two or more people, extra bedroom may be used for study, playroom, etc. Huge kitchen with Bosch gas stove and Bosch dishwasher and plenty of counter space. Primary bedroom has 16-foot high ceiling with loft area; it has a queen bed, en suite full bathroom, and two walk in closets. Bedroom two has a king bed and TV with Roku; bedroom three has a queen bed; and bedroom four has a twin bed. All bedrooms have big closets, all on second floor. Tremendous full bathroom on second floor with many shelves. Several desks and dressers can be moved around as needed. Attached garage, plus plenty of room for parking in the driveway. Living room has classic wood stove (there's also conventional baseboard heat throughout house from high efficiency Buderus boiler), Roku TV, laser printer, two couches and comfy TV chair. Dining area with seating for six. Large wraparound deck with grill, dining area and country views, accessed from front and kitchen doors. Samsung washer and dryer in first floor laundry room. Lots of built-in shelving throughout. Rent shown is for 9-month lease; 12-months also available for 8% more. Ithaca School District with school bus service. Located on a great country setting that you will enjoy!

ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. Community Amenities: - Modern resident lobby with comfortable seating areas - Game and media lounge with pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs - Speakeasy-style resident lounge - Interactive game simulator, including a golf simulator - Fully equipped fitness center - Private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces - Rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and games - Secure bike storage

ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. Community Amenities: - Modern resident lobby with comfortable seating areas - Game and media lounge with pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs - Speakeasy-style resident lounge - Interactive game simulator, including a golf simulator - Fully equipped fitness center - Private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces - Rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and games - Secure bike storage

ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. Community Amenities: - Modern resident lobby with comfortable seating areas - Game and media lounge with pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs - Speakeasy-style resident lounge - Interactive game simulator, including a golf simulator - Fully equipped fitness center - Private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces - Rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and games - Secure bike storage

ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. Community Amenities: - Modern resident lobby with comfortable seating areas - Game and media lounge with pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs - Speakeasy-style resident lounge - Interactive game simulator, including a golf simulator - Fully equipped fitness center - Private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces - Rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and games - Secure bike storage

ShortDescription: 3 Bedroom – 3C | The Bear Welcome to The Bear at 215 College Avenue, a brand-new luxury student housing community in the heart of Collegetown. Located just steps from Cornell University, The Bear offers thoughtfully designed residences, premium amenities, and vibrant community spaces that support every aspect of student life. The 3 Bedroom – 3C is a thoughtfully designed shared residence that combines comfort, style, and functionality in an efficient 817-square-foot layout. Ideal for roommates, this floor plan features three private bedrooms, two shared bathrooms, and an open-concept kitchen and living area that provides a comfortable space to study, relax, cook, and spend time together. Designed with modern student living in mind, the 3 Bedroom – 3C makes the most of every square foot while maintaining a bright, open atmosphere. Contemporary finishes and a streamlined layout create a welcoming environment, while each private bedroom offers a quiet retreat for studying or unwinding after a busy day. Every bedroom includes a built-in closet for convenient storage. Please note that 3 Bedroom – 3C residences do not include a balcony. Each apartment comes fully furnished and features stainless steel appliances, white marbled quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, an in-unit washer and dryer, a Smart TV, an electric fireplace, and premium finishes throughout. The Bear is also a pet-friendly community, welcoming both dogs and cats. Living in the 3 Bedroom – 3C means enjoying much more than your apartment. Residents have access to an exceptional collection of community spaces designed for studying, wellness, and socializing. Meet friends in the game and media lounge featuring pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs, unwind in the speakeasy-inspired resident lounge, or take advantage of private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces throughout the building. When it's time to recharge, residents can work out in the fully equipped fitness center, enjoy the interactive game simulator—including a golf simulator—or relax on the fifth-floor rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and lawn games. As a resident of The Bear, you'll also enjoy reciprocal access to The Ivy's amenities, expanding your access to additional study spaces, fitness amenities, and social areas across both luxury student housing communities. With only two 3 Bedroom – 3C residences remaining in the entire building, this floor plan offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern, well-designed student housing in one of Collegetown's newest luxury communities. Featuring private bedrooms, stylish finishes, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location just steps from Cornell University, the 3 Bedroom – 3C is an excellent choice for students seeking a comfortable and connected shared living experience. Community Amenities: - Modern resident lobby with comfortable seating areas - Game and media lounge with pool tables, air hockey, arcade games, and Smart TVs - Speakeasy-style resident lounge - Interactive game simulator, including a golf simulator - Fully equipped fitness center - Private study rooms, study pods, and collaborative workspaces - Rooftop terrace with outdoor seating and games - Secure bike storage
